parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ "mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and trashed=false and (name contains 'Stor' or name contains 'Reel') and (" + (($json.files || []).map(f => "'" + f.id + "' in parents").join(' or ') || "'none' in parents") + ')' }}

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ "mimeType contains 'video/' and trashed=false and (" + (($json.files || []).map(f => "'" + f.id + "' in parents").join(' or ') || "'none' in parents") + ')' }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('Settings').first().json.CLAUDE_MODEL, max_tokens: 3000, system: $json.system, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.userContent }] }) }}

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().filter((i) => (i.json._tab || 'stories') === 'stories').map((i) => { const j = Object.assign({}, i.json); delete j._tab; return { json: j }; });
return $input.all().filter((i) => i.json._tab === 'chat').map((i) => { const j = Object.assign({}, i.json); delete j._tab; return { json: j }; });
return $input.all().filter((i) => i.json._tab === 'offers').map((i) => { const j = Object.assign({}, i.json); delete j._tab; return { json: j }; });
